Messages.Body:
Will there be cards reprinted from DS/AH?

I ask because I found that, for example, alot of the Chimerstry cards
just cost way too much to play with! 1 and 2 blood costs and
practically all of them!

Reducing alot of those costs on some of those cards would go along way
towards making the Ravnos playable.

Will input be taken on suggestions to this end (card revisions or new
cards) OR is the card list already done for this expansion more or
less?

T

Messages.Author: Frederick Scott
Messages.Body:


Considering the cards are probably being printed as we write, the card
list is certainly done. Think about it...the cards will be at the retailers
in June, and work backwards in time. By what timeline could there possibly
be any leeway at this moment?

Anyway, no company that puts out CCGs that I know of, including White Wolf,
takes suggestions about new cards or exact card revisions anyway. They'll
listen to your opinions about existing cards and act accordingly. Given the
three new "Path" cards in Sabbat War and that these cards have been reasonably
well received, expect to see "Path of reducing-the-cost-of-Chimistry" and
Quietus/Necromancy/Serpentis also. That should help somewhat.

Fred

Messages.Author: Chris Shorb
Messages.Body:


I remember a thread wherein many of the Net Personalities on this
Newsgroup were urging LSJ to create a card wherein you actually got a
capacity modifier in exchange for burning your vamp, while adding a
counter to it to draw two cards, put a counter on an uncontrolled vamp,
and also gaining an extra pool for the edge, all while giving you the
permanent ability to add pool from the blood bank to an uncontrolled
vamp for every blood you influenced onto any of your vamps. And while a
few NCL zealots thought such a card should cost 1 pool, cooler heads
prevailed, and a zero cost was decided on. But I think such a card
would really be wallpaper - what we really need is a card that gives you
+1 intercept when someone tries to diablerize your vampires - but let's
make sure it isn't too powerful and only limit it to vamps who have
Necromancy. Even better would be a card that forces everyone to talk
like either Jackie Chan in English, Chris Rock in Chinese, or Marlee
Matlin (Children of a Lesser God) in ASL, or they are immediately ousted
- wouldn't that be really balancing and fair?

No really, I remember a thread like that, let me just look it up here on
Deja...

Chris
